purpose: Daily and on-demand backfill of type/area/priority labels on issues that have no type:* label, delegating the labelling to scripts/workflows/apply-labels-workflow.js.

jobs.summary: Checkout, setup Node, npm ci; github-script paginates issues.listForRepo (state all, optional since window) and writes issues without a type:* label to issues-to-label.json; runs apply-labels-workflow.js; logs and uploads labeling-report.json.

failure_points.issue: Referenced script scripts/workflows/apply-labels-workflow.js does not exist; the Apply labels step fails whenever any unlabelled issue is found.
DRY_RUN expression `inputs.dry_run == 'true' || 'true'` always evaluates to 'true', so the workflow could never apply labels (scheduled or manual).
Fetch errors are caught and turned into count=0 with a green run (silent failure).
state: 'all' includes closed issues in the backfill set.
Scheduled at 02:00 UTC, inside the 02:00/03:00/04:00 schedule cluster the active workflow was staggered away from.

overlaps_with: labeling-unified.yml (agent applies default and content-detected type labels on issue events)
